'''Krayt dragon venom''' came from the [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was often found in the possession of nefarious characters, and was lethal if delivered in a powdered form.

[[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] often carried krayt dragon venom.
